### hs-sales-reporting

- Authority: first-party · stage 6 · status GRADED (graded 2026-09-21)
- Trust badges: READ-ONLY, EVIDENCE-GATED
  - READ-ONLY: Briefings, pipeline snapshots and win/loss analysis. Reads only.
